description: Serve DeepSeek and Qwen, run an on-demand model library, and fine-tune with Unsloth QLoRA on 2x NVIDIA DGX Spark. TP=2 vLLM lanes behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint for OpenCode, Cursor, and Hermes. Honest benchmarks, committed artifacts.
